objective: Define the asynchronous Action, proposal, delayed GM decision and durable inbox contract so one submitted proposal produces at most one attributable authoritative outcome through existing A6 Action/proposal/Event architecture.
design_findings: Async play reuses A6; no second rules engine.
One proposalId produces at most one final authoritative outcome.
Revisions keep proposalId, increment version, use new operation identity and preserve prior provenance.
Semantic stale changes require explicit proposer refresh/revision; no silent recomputation.
Withdrawal/revocation/expiry are attributable non-gameplay dispositions resolved safely against racing final decisions.
Clarification is nonfinal and cannot rewrite Player intent.
GM inbox ordering/assignment/review leases are coordination only.
Final decisions reauthorize current delegation, versions, permissions, entitlements and legality.
Notifications are minimal attention signals and deep links reauthorize.
Reconnect uses status lookup/event recovery before retry; no blind state-changing resend.
AI/automation cannot decide, revise intent, expand delegation or commit.
